name: The Abomination

abilities.name: Frenzied Rampage
abilities.description: Flails at an adjacent foe in a frenzy: three separate strikes for 1d10+4 each. Once per phase.

abilities.name: Crushing Grip
abilities.description: Seizes an adjacent foe for 2d6+4. On a hit, the foe is pinned and can't move through the next DM phase. Once per phase.

abilities.name: Graveyard Slam
abilities.description: Brings both fists down on the floor, attacking every foe within 1 for 2d8+4. Once per phase.

abilities.name: Stitched Flesh
abilities.description: Dead flesh barely feels pain: every hit it takes is reduced by 4 through the next DM phase. Once per phase.

abilities.name: Furious Bellow
abilities.description: Lets out a furious bellow. Each foe within 3 that doesn't resist must attack it while it can, through the next DM phase. Once per phase.

description: The necromancer's rogue creation, loose in Blackthorn and unusually cunning for an undead. Mark hostile when the party fights it.

name: The Necromancer

abilities.name: Raise Thralls
abilities.description: Calls the dead to rise. Rolls 1d4: the DM raises that many thralls (zombies, skeletons or spirits) nearby. Once per phase.

abilities.name: Deathly Pall
abilities.description: A cloud of grave-cold mist bursts around a foe within 8, attacking every foe within 2 of it for 2d8+3. Once per phase.

abilities.name: Life Siphon
abilities.description: Draws the life out of a foe within 8 for 2d6+4. On a hit, she heals 2d6+4.

abilities.name: Soul Shackle
abilities.description: Spectral chains seize a foe within 6. If it doesn't resist, it can't move and loses 1 action through the next DM phase. Once per phase.

abilities.name: Bone Ward
abilities.description: A lattice of bone snaps up around the necromancer and absorbs the next hit she takes. Once per phase.

description: A local necromancer experimenting with raising the dead as intelligent thralls. Raise Thralls is a roll: place the thralls yourself. Mark hostile when the party fights her.

name: Constable Huxley

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.description: Rams an adjacent foe with a watch shield for 1d6+2. On a hit, the foe is shaken (−2 to hit) through the next DM phase.

description: Blackthorn's constable, a veteran who regularly hires the party as bounty hunters. Gives the opening briefing on the rogue abomination. Wants the city safe and the job done quietly.

name: The Baker
description: Runs a bakery in Blackthorn. A witness to one of the creature's sightings.

name: Mortuary Worker
description: Keeps the city morgue and its records.

name: June Steeman
description: A visitor to Blackthorn, staying at a hotel in town with her son James.

name: James Steeman
description: June's young son, visiting Blackthorn with her.

name: Silas Grey

abilities.name: Twin Blades
abilities.description: Rapier and parrying dagger strike an adjacent foe: two separate attacks for 1d8+3 each. Once per phase.

abilities.name: Call the Guild
abilities.description: A sharp whistle. Rolls 1d4: the DM brings in that many thieves from the shadows. Once per phase.

abilities.name: Smoke and Mirrors
abilities.description: Vanishes in a puff of smoke and reappears up to 4 squares away with +2 Defense through the next DM phase. Once per phase.

description: Guildmaster of the thieves who run the Blind Eye Tavern. Old, patient and polite; never fights fair and never fights alone.

name: Mira Vex

abilities.name: Blinding Powder
abilities.description: Flings powder into a foe's eyes within 3. If it doesn't resist, it is shaken (−2 to hit) through the next DM phase. Once per phase.

description: The guild's spymaster and Silas's right hand. Knows everyone's secrets in Blackthorn and trades them carefully.

name: Kane

abilities.name: Hamstring
abilities.description: A low cut at an adjacent foe's legs for 1d8+3. On a hit, the foe is slowed (−2 movement) through the next DM phase.

description: The guild's enforcer. Quiet, disciplined and utterly loyal to Silas Grey. Collects debts that others can't.

name: Brother Grim

abilities.name: Haymaker
abilities.description: A huge swing at an adjacent foe for 2d6+4. On a hit, the foe is dazed and loses 1 action through the next DM phase. Once per phase.

description: A defrocked monk turned guild bruiser. Covered in scars and old prayers; speaks rarely and hits very hard.

name: Nightshade

abilities.name: Envenomed Dart
abilities.description: A poisoned dart at a foe within 8 for 1d6+3. On a hit, the foe is poisoned (−2 to hit) for 5 rounds.

description: The guild's poisoner. Charming, theatrical and fond of her work. Never drinks anything she didn't pour herself.

name: Masked Cutpurse

abilities.name: Backstab
abilities.description: A vicious stab at an adjacent foe for 2d6+2.

description: A faceless guild thief. Says nothing, takes everything.

name: Wren

abilities.name: Melt into Shadow
abilities.description: Slips into the shadows and reappears up to 3 squares away. Free action, once per phase.

description: A young guild burglar, quick and quiet. Climbs anything.

name: Dashiell Crane

abilities.name: Quick Fingers
abilities.description: Tries to lift an item from an adjacent creature. Rolls 1d20+6; the DM decides what, if anything, is taken.

description: "Dash" to his friends. A charming pickpocket who talks fast and runs faster.

name: Imani Sol

abilities.name: Tip-Off
abilities.description: Signals a weak spot to an ally within 6, who adds 1d4 to their next attack roll.

description: Runs the card tables at the Blind Eye. Never loses a hand she doesn't mean to.

name: Nix

abilities.name: Fan of Knives
abilities.description: Throws a spread of knives at a foe within 5, attacking every foe within 1 of it for 1d4+2. Once per phase.

description: A tattooed knife-thrower with a mean streak. Practices on the tavern's dartboard, and sometimes on its patrons.

name: Valeria

abilities.name: Distracting Patter
abilities.description: Sweet talk and misdirection at a foe within 4. If it doesn't resist, it loses 1 action through the next DM phase. Once per phase.

description: The guild's con artist. Can be anyone's long-lost cousin by the end of a conversation.

name: Old Bram

abilities.name: Headlock
abilities.description: Grabs an adjacent foe for 1d6+2. On a hit, the foe is held and can't move through the next DM phase.

description: Ex-sailor and the Blind Eye's bouncer. Decides who gets through the back door to the guild.

name: Barlow

abilities.name: Sound the Alarm
abilities.description: A coded whistle to warn the guild. Rolls 1d20+3; the DM decides who hears it and comes running.

description: Watches the street outside the Blind Eye. Sees who comes and goes, and remembers faces.

name: Red Maggie

abilities.name: Stiff Drink
abilities.description: Pours something strong for herself or an adjacent ally, healing 1d6+2.

description: Keeps the bar at the Blind Eye Tavern, the guild's front. Hears everything, repeats only what's paid for.

name: Don Aurelio Falcone

abilities.name: Crushing Embrace
abilities.description: Pulls an adjacent foe into a bone-cracking embrace for 2d10+4. On a hit, the foe can't move through the next DM phase. Once per phase.

abilities.name: Sweeping Cane
abilities.description: A heavy sweep of the cane, attacking every foe within 1 for 2d6+5. Once per phase.

abilities.name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
abilities.description: A quiet word and a cold stare at a foe within 4. If it doesn't resist, it is frightened (can't move closer to him) and shaken (−2 to hit) through the next DM phase. Once per phase.

abilities.name: Immovable
abilities.description: Sets his considerable weight and shrugs off blows: every hit he takes is reduced by 3 through the next DM phase. Once per phase.

abilities.name: Call the Family
abilities.description: Snaps his fingers. Rolls 1d4: the DM brings in that many syndicate soldiers. Once per phase.

description: Head of the Falcone crime family, which runs Blackthorn's rackets. Soft-spoken, courteous and enormous; prefers to settle things with an offer, but is far more dangerous in a fight than he looks.

name: Rafael Falcone

abilities.name: Flourish
abilities.description: A showy duelist's combination at an adjacent foe: two separate strikes for 1d8+3 each. Once per phase.

description: The Don's son and underboss. Vain, quick-tempered and an excellent swordsman; eager to prove himself to his father.

name: Sofia Falcone

abilities.name: Leverage
abilities.description: Reminds a foe within 5 of something it would rather keep quiet. If it doesn't resist, it hesitates and loses 1 action through the next DM phase. Once per phase.

description: The Don's daughter, who keeps the family's books. The sharpest mind in the room, and she knows it. Negotiates for the family.

name: Marcus Vane

abilities.name: Capo's Command
abilities.description: Barks an order at an ally within 6, who adds 1d6 to their next attack roll.

description: The family's capo, who runs the soldiers on the street. Cold, efficient and loyal to the Don above all.

name: Big Tomas

abilities.name: Human Shield
abilities.description: Steps in front of an adjacent ally (usually the Don) and takes the next hit meant for them.

abilities.name: Bear Hug
abilities.description: Wraps up an adjacent foe for 1d10+4. On a hit, the foe can't move through the next DM phase. Once per phase.

description: The Don's personal bodyguard. A mountain of a man who never leaves his boss's side and rarely says a word.

name: Grigor "the Anvil"

abilities.name: Skull Crack
abilities.description: Brings the hammer down on an adjacent foe's head for 2d6+4. On a hit, the foe is dazed and loses 1 action through the next DM phase. Once per phase.

description: The family's leg-breaker. Tattooed, patient and very thorough. Visits people who are late with payments.

name: One-Eye Corvo

abilities.name: Execution Shot
abilities.description: A careful, deadly shot at a foe within 8 for 2d8+4, treating its Defense as 3 lower. Once per phase.

description: The family's hired gun. Lost the eye in a duel he still won. Never misses twice.

name: Lucia

abilities.name: Dance of Knives
abilities.description: A whirl of blades at an adjacent foe: three separate strikes for 1d4+2 each. Once per phase.

description: Fences the family's goods and handles quiet problems with a knife. Smiles a great deal.

name: Old Hatch

abilities.name: Steady Aim
abilities.description: Takes his time lining up the shot: +3 on his next attack roll.

description: The family's old hand: driver, lookout and marksman. Has worked for the Falcones since before the Don was Don.
